Zamana Jaan Le Haider Ki Zulfiqar Hoon Main –
Jo Aik Bar Bana Hai Woh Shahkar Hoon Main
Zamana Jan Le Haider Ki Zulfiqar Hoon Main
Main Aaj Apna Taruf Tumhein Karati Hoon
Hijab Apni Hi Khilqat Se Main Uthati Hoon
Hasab Nasab Hai Mera Kya Abhi Batati Hoon
Main Misal-e-Meesum-o-Salmaan Ali Ki Sathi Hoon
Khuda Ne Noor Ki Aatish Mein Mujh Ko Dhala Hai
Falak Pe Kitne Baras Kibriya Ne Pala Hai
Ohad Ke Ran Mein Meri Rasam-e-Ronomai Hoi
Zameen Pe Pehle Hi Din Kufar Se Larai Hoi
Ali Ki Qowat-e-Bazu Se Aashnai Hoi
Shikast Roney Lagi Aisi Jag Hansai Hoi
Khuda Ne Gaib Se Lashkar Kushai Di Hai Mujhe
Rasool-e-Pak Ne Khud Munh Dikhai Di Hai Mujhe
Har Ik Jarri Mere Johar Ka Madah Khuwan Raha
Meri Amma Se Jo Nikla Woh Be Aman Raha
Bashar Raha Na Koi Jism Par Nishan Raha
Hamesha Jang Mein Mujh Ko Yeh Itmenan Raha
Abu Turab Ne Mujh Par Yeh Aytbar Kiya
Palat Ke Lash Na Dekhi Jo Main Ne Waar Kiya
Munafiqon Ko Naye Mojzay Dikhati Hoon
Ali Ali Ka Jahan Ko Sabaq Sikhati Hoon
Qaza Ko Apne Isharon Pe Main Nachati Hoon
Saron Ko Sar Se Hawaon Mein Main Urati Hoon
Ali Ke Hath Pe Sajdah Meri Ibadat Hai
Khuda Ke Hath Mein Rehne Ki Mujh Ko Adat Hai
Fidak Ke Roz Yeh Main Ne Kaha Tha Maula Se
Mere Imam Waga Ki Mujhe Raza De De
Hoye Hain Loag Jo Mujrim Janab-e-Zahra Ke
Har Aik Ashk Ki Qeemat Abhi Chokaein Gay
Kissi Ko Mujh Se Muyassar Rahe Farrar Nahi
Jigar Na Kaat Ke Rakh Doon Tu Zulfiqar Nahi
Main Kitni Sadiyon Se AKBAR Ossi Deyar Mein Hoon
Ali Ke Shair Ke Humrah Main Kachar Mein Hoon
Main Meer-e-Ghaibat-e-Kubra Ke Ikhteyar Mein Hoon
Main Apne Izn-e-Takallum Ke Intezar Mein Hoon
Kissi Zabaan Se Jahan Al-Ajal Nikalta Hai
Niyam-e-Sabar Mein Mera Badan Machalta Hai
